project_summary: Distributed World Simulator is developed through parallel domain programs under one canonical main-owned architecture and control ledger. Generation 61 is a convergence snapshot: T1B is accepted handoff evidence, G8.6 and CH9.6 await only manual graphical gates, C22 remains source-accepted but requires current-main convergence refresh, and NX.C0 is a clean main-based preparation frontier.

G.short_description: Procedural geomorphology over accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
G.purpose: Finish G8 with deterministic geomorphology and a truthful visual lab before geology starts.
G.expected_outcome: G8 closes with invariant canonical geomorphology and presentation-only LOD/seam behavior; G9 starts only after MAT identity is available under R3.
G.progress_note: Exact-Windows automated acceptance passed on a9ca1f8b723e4edc5ebff40db26e41283d464597, including focused G8.6, G8.5 parent, LOD/truth separation, PX/PZ seam diagnostics and full world/core regression. Only user-observed graphical acceptance remains.
G.next_stage: Perform the G8.6 manual graphical gate on the preserved tested checkout; if PASS, record G8.6 ACCEPTED, run G8 Full Acceptance, freeze G8 evidence, and do not start G9 until canonical MAT0/R3 gating is satisfied.

T.short_description: Accepted Construction composition/failure/recovery handoff evidence over T1A.7 runtime recovery, interest, durability and M3 replication.
T.purpose: Preserve the accepted T1B semantics as evidence while global Construction scale/integration converges.
T.expected_outcome: No T1B.5. The next Construction implementation frontier is T2.0 only after C22 integration, TS0.4 ceiling classification and PC0 convergence.
T.progress_note: T1B.0 through T1B.4 are accepted; executable checkout 88736b1e57a5fb96d80c8842ea983c20d8b833f3 passed the 93-assertion M3 failure/recovery composition gate and preserved full world/core regression. SOURCE_ACCEPTED=true, MAIN_INTEGRATED=false, COMPOSITION_VERIFIED=true, PRODUCTION_READY=false.
T.last_accepted_checkpoint: T1B.4 Composition Acceptance / T1B Aggregate Handoff
T.next_stage: No new T1B stage. Keep the branch frozen as accepted handoff evidence. Resume T only after C22 current-main refresh/integration and TS0.4 classification clear the T2.0 convergence gate.

TS.short_description: Source-accepted production convergence of TS0.3 local dirty-section evidence into the real C22/C24 Construction proxy pipeline.
TS.purpose: Land accepted incremental C22 behavior into current main without altering canonical Construction truth or derived-presentation semantics.
TS.expected_outcome: A fresh main-based convergence refresh reproduces the accepted C22 production diff, passes C22/C24 focused validation plus full world/core regression, then becomes explicitly mergeable.
TS.progress_note: The source implementation remains accepted. PR #59 is currently non-mergeable and the source branch is 70 main commits behind its original base. Direct comparison shows those 70 main commits are control/architecture/docs only and do not touch C22 production proxy/runtime files, so this is an ancestry/control convergence blocker rather than a semantic C22 defect.
TS.last_accepted_checkpoint: TS0.3 / C22 Production Incremental Convergence SOURCE_ACCEPTED
TS.next_stage: Create a fresh current-main C22 convergence refresh, reproduce/prove the accepted production diff, rerun focused C22/C24 and full regression, then return to MERGE_READY. Merge requires explicit authorization; after merge run PC0 and create TS0.4 from canonical main.

CH.short_description: Playable graphical composition of Inventory UI, server-authoritative network equipment, durable recovery and real Quaternius presentation.
CH.purpose: Close the playable equipment vertical slice without introducing speculative equipment authority or a duplicate Item Graph path.
CH.expected_outcome: UI equipment, server confirmation, presenter state and restart recovery all remain consistent on the real character.
CH.progress_note: Windows automated acceptance is complete. Runtime head 7b2269b39952b8201714a7078a62b8f97057325c and tested executable/focused/full head 4cdafddce7cd6b5fa7ff45a06ae00f06320464ab pass CH9.2 UI routes 16, CH9.3 real ENet 20, CH9.4 reconnect/recovery 53, CH9.5 persistent ENet recovery 41 and CH9.6 playable UI/network/presenter 22 assertions. Only the manual graphical restart/recovery observation remains.
CH.last_accepted_checkpoint: CH9.5 Live Equipment Runtime Composition FOCUSED_ACCEPTED
CH.next_stage: Run the two-pass graphical CH9.6 acceptance on preserved checkout 4cdafddc: equip/unequip plus movement, close normally, relaunch without ResetState, verify automatic restored presentation and post-recovery unequip. Then record CH9.6 acceptance and run post-acceptance PC0 before any later CH stage.

DOCTRINE.short_description: Design doctrine describing how a large simulated world produces discovery, capability, infrastructure, consequences and history.
DOCTRINE.purpose: Keep gameplay/world-building principles reusable and aligned with technical foundations without giving design documentation ownership of identity, authority, material or persistence systems.
DOCTRINE.expected_outcome: A durable design reference used to judge whether new simulation mechanics create interesting interconnected gameplay rather than isolated features.
DOCTRINE.progress_note: Doctrine remains an active design reference and must map new mechanics onto canonical queries, operations, transactions and persistent world consequences.
DOCTRINE.next_stage: Continue doctrine updates only when new gameplay/system evidence appears

NX.short_description: Clean main-based convergence of proven owner-authority network evidence without importing the legacy FIX ladder or render/physics violations.
NX.purpose: Reimplement the minimal owner-authority capability over canonical main while preserving server-owned gameplay truth, Item Graph authority, durability and single-writer physics/presentation separation.
NX.expected_outcome: NX gains a maintainable OWNER_AUTHORITATIVE_VALIDATED profile, smooth remote interpolation and rollback-safe optimistic item presentation with bounded input metadata handling.
NX.progress_note: NX.C0 remains control/docs only and therefore runtime freshness is not applicable. The legacy M7/FIX lineage is evidence only. Before NX.C1 begins, PC0 directional watched-dependency hardening must be integrated and the NX implementation branch must be refreshed from then-current canonical main.
NX.last_accepted_checkpoint: NX5 Remote Snapshot Interpolation baseline; M7 owner-authority vertical slice retained as legacy evidence
NX.next_stage: After PC0 directional-watch hardening lands, create/refresh the NX.C1 runtime branch from current main. Reimplement only the minimal authority profile/service/client-server composition and same-revision item rollback; turn NX YELLOW until exact-Windows focused/full/two-client/dependency validation restores GREEN.

MATTER.short_description: Authoritative mutable material/volume truth with durable same-body cross-region transactions and recovery.
MATTER.purpose: Provide persistent excavation/material mutation semantics for later Geo and Construction composition.
MATTER.expected_outcome: MW10 remains the accepted transaction baseline until GM/T3/T5 composition requires new declared work.
MATTER.progress_note: No active Matter frontier is declared; MW10 remains the stable baseline.
MATTER.next_stage: GM Geo-Matter integration / future composition gate

S1.short_description: Proposal-only distributed compute where workers receive projected immutable state and authority commits validated mutations.
S1.purpose: Scale simulation work without allowing workers to become authoritative world owners.
S1.expected_outcome: Reusable compute execution for future generation, AI and simulation workloads under explicit read/write contracts.
S1.progress_note: No active S1 frontier is declared.
S1.next_stage: Register a new frontier only when a concrete workload requires it

convergence_order.principle: Do not open a new major runtime frontier from an old stacked lineage. Accepted legacy branches become evidence; new convergence/runtime work starts from the then-current canonical main unless a registered stacked dependency is intentional.
